# Mission Title ## Roadmap Week Week __ - ____________________ ## What I Built Write 3-5 lines explaining the mission. ## Files Created - index.html / App.jsx / server.js / etc. ## How To Run Write the exact command or browser steps. ## Features Completed - [ ] Feature 1 - [ ] Feature 2 - [ ] Feature 3 ## Test Results - Test 1: Pass/Fail - Test 2: Pass/Fail ## Bugs Faced Describe the bug and how you fixed it. ## Elliot Connection Explain how this mission helps build Elliot V1.
Appendix B - Ask Lemont Debug Prompt
Use this whenever you are blocked. Replace the blanks with your real mission details.
Appendix C - Final Elliot V1 Acceptance Standard
Elliot V1 is not complete because it looks nice. Elliot V1 is complete when it performs useful assistant behavior and has proof that it can be run, tested, and explained.
Web interface exists and is usable.
Mobile interface or mobile-tested version exists.
Chat interface works with user and assistant messages.
Notes or tasks can be saved.
Basic personal/project knowledge can be displayed or queried.
Backend API exists or local mock backend is clearly documented.
Basic text upload/paste understanding exists.
README explains how to run the project.
GitHub repository is organized.
Demo path is documented or recorded.
V2 features are clearly separated from V1 scope.

checkpoints.question: Can I install, verify, and use VS Code, Node, npm, Git, and GitHub without panic?
Can I use variables, functions, arrays, objects, loops, JSON, and conditionals to model real project data?
Can I build pages that respond to clicks, forms, and saved local data?
Can I commit, push, write README notes, and preserve evidence of work?
Can I build reusable components, use state, render lists, create routes, and persist data?
Can I create Express routes that return and update JSON data?
Can I make an app more mobile-friendly, installable, reliable, and product-ready?
Can I run a React Native/Expo app on my Samsung A70 and connect it to data?
Can Elliot V1 run on web/mobile, save notes/tasks, answer from personal data, read basic documents, and connect to a backend?
